message.content: The most celebrated sculpture of the 19th century is generally considered **“The Kiss” (Le Baiser) by Auguste Rodin** (completed in 1889). It epitomizes the era’s shift toward expressive, emotionally charged realism and remains one of the most reproduced and admired works of art from that period.
